_comment: Hand-scored council verdicts for the followed-tickers judge gate (docs/tickers-followed.md follow-up item 6). Every judge run re-grades this set; if the judge's agreement with `goldTotal` (±1 on the 0-10 sum) drops below 80%, that run's scores are discarded. This is MANUAL work — it must NOT be generated by the model being evaluated. The set deliberately spans excellent / mediocre / ungrounded so drift in any direction is visible. Expand toward ~20 entries as real verdicts accumulate; the three below are the seed.
